# The \#TidyTuesday data viewer

The \#TidyTuesday data viewer (`ttdviewer`) is a Shiny app-package[^1]
for viewing data from the [`#TidyTuesday`
project](https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday). It has the
features below:

1.  The data are loaded directly from GitHub. The index of titles and
    file URLs is built with the
    [`tidytuesdayR`](https://dslc-io.github.io/tidytuesdayR/) and
    [`ttmeta`](https://r4ds.github.io/ttmeta/) packages.
2.  The returned object is visible as a list on the first `nav_panel()`
    via the [`listviewerlite`
    package](https://long39ng.github.io/listviewerlite/).  
3.  The Summary tab shows the number of files, summary statistics,
    variable information (type, missing values, unique values), and the
    data itself (first 1,000 rows) for each file, using the [`reactable`
    package](https://glin.github.io/reactable/).  
4.  Data visualizations from the [`inspectdf`
    package](https://alastairrushworth.com/inspectdf/) ‘*summarise
    missingness, categorical levels, numeric distribution, correlation,
    column types and memory usage*’ are available on the Graphs tab.
5.  The sidebar downloads the data as CSV, parquet, or the original file
    format. Titles with several files download as one `.zip`.

## Architecture

The app is packaged as a Shiny application with a single entry point
that wires UI and server logic together. The server loads the selected
dataset, routes it through module servers, and then exposes the reactive
outputs to the UI panels.

``` mermaid
%%{init: {'theme': 'neutral', 'look': 'handDrawn', 'themeVariables': { 'fontFamily': 'monospace', 'fontSize':'11px'}}}%%
flowchart LR
  Launch["launch()"] --> UI["app_ui()"]
  Launch --> Server["app_server()"]
  Server --> Input["mod_input_server()"]
  Input --> Data["load_tt_data()"]
  Server --> Download["mod_download_server()"]
  Download --> WriteDownload["write_tt_download()"]
  Server --> Summary["mod_summary_server()"]
  Server --> List["mod_list_server()"]
  Server --> Plot["mod_plot_server()"]
  Plot --> InspectPlot["inspect_plot()"]
  Data --> Summary
  Data --> Download
  Data --> List
  Data --> Plot
```

The UI arranges module outputs into panels while the sidebar hosts the
dataset selector and the data download.

``` mermaid
%%{init: {'theme': 'neutral', 'look': 'handDrawn', 'themeVariables': { 'fontFamily': 'monospace', 'fontSize':'13px'}}}%%
flowchart LR
  Sidebar["Sidebar inputs"] --> InputUI["mod_input_ui()"]
  Sidebar --> DownloadUI["mod_download_ui()"]
  Tabs["Tab panels"] --> ListUI["mod_list_ui()"]
  Tabs --> SummaryUI["mod_summary_ui()"]
  Tabs --> PlotUI["mod_plot_ui()"]
```

Supporting utilities and tests wrap the core modules. Logging, data
helpers, and download writers are kept in standalone R files, while
`tests/testthat` validates module behavior and data helpers.

``` mermaid
%%{init: {'theme': 'neutral', 'look': 'handDrawn', 'themeVariables': { 'fontFamily': 'monospace', 'fontSize':'14px'}}}%%
flowchart TB
  subgraph Utilities
    Log["logr_msg()"]
    Ctr["ctr()"]
    Load["load_tt_data()"]
    Inspect["inspect_plot()"]
    Write["write_tt_download()"]
    Summarise["tt_file_summary() / tt_var_info()"]
  end
  subgraph Modules
    ModInput["mod_input_*"]
    ModList["mod_list_*"]
    ModPlot["mod_plot_*"]
    ModSummary["mod_summary_*"]
    ModDownload["mod_download_*"]
  end
  Utilities --> Modules
```

``` mermaid
%%{init: {'theme': 'neutral', 'look': 'handDrawn', 'themeVariables': { 'fontFamily': 'monospace', 'fontSize':'14px'}}}%%
flowchart TB
  subgraph Tests
    TestApp["test-app_*"]
    TestModules["test-mod_*"]
    TestUtils["test-load_tt_data / test-inspect_plot / test-download_tt_data / test-logr_msg"]
  end
  Modules --> Tests
  Utilities --> Tests
```

## Installation

You can install the development version of `ttdviewer` from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("mjfrigaard/ttdviewer")
```

## Launch app

Launch the application using the standalone app function below. By
default
[`launch()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/ttdviewer/reference/launch.md)
runs the app in the background and returns a handle, so the console
stays available:

``` r

library(ttdviewer)
handle <- launch()
handle$stop()
```

Use `launch(mode = "run")` to return the app object instead (e.g., in an
`app.R` file for deployment).

[^1]: An R package containing a Shiny application. Read more
    [here](https://mastering-shiny.org/scaling-packaging.html).

## All functions

- [`app_server()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/ttdviewer/reference/app_server.md)
  : Application Server
- [`app_ui()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/ttdviewer/reference/app_ui.md)
  : Application UI
- [`check_col_types()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/ttdviewer/reference/check_col_types.md)
  : Check Column Types in TidyTuesday Data
- [`check_ttd_cat_cols()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/ttdviewer/reference/check_ttd_cat_cols.md)
  : Check for Categorical (Character) Columns in TidyTuesday Data
- [`check_ttd_date_cols()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/ttdviewer/reference/check_ttd_date_cols.md)
  : Check for Date Columns in TidyTuesday Data
- [`check_ttd_list_cols()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/ttdviewer/reference/check_ttd_list_cols.md)
  : Check for List Columns in TidyTuesday Data
- [`check_ttd_log_cols()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/ttdviewer/reference/check_ttd_log_cols.md)
  : Check for Logical Columns in TidyTuesday Data
- [`check_ttd_num_cols()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/ttdviewer/reference/check_ttd_num_cols.md)
  : Check for Numeric Columns in TidyTuesday Data
- [`clean_title_string()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/ttdviewer/reference/clean_title_string.md)
  : Clean Title String
- [`ctr()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/ttdviewer/reference/ctr.md) :
  Print a colorized tree representation of an R object
- [`extract_dataset_title()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/ttdviewer/reference/extract_dataset_title.md)
  : Extract and Clean Dataset Title
- [`extract_file_names()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/ttdviewer/reference/extract_file_names.md)
  : Extract File Names from TidyTuesday Data Object
- [`get_intersecting_cols()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/ttdviewer/reference/get_intersecting_cols.md)
  : Get Intersecting Column Names Between Two Datasets
- [`get_tt_title_meta()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/ttdviewer/reference/get_tt_title_meta.md)
  : Get Dataset Metadata
- [`has_min_cols()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/ttdviewer/reference/has_min_cols.md)
  : Check if Dataset Has Minimum Required Columns
- [`inspect_plot()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/ttdviewer/reference/inspect_plot.md)
  : Inspect and Plot TidyTuesday Data
- [`launch()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/ttdviewer/reference/launch.md)
  : Launch the \#TidyTuesday Data Viewer
- [`load_tt_data()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/ttdviewer/reference/load_tt_data.md)
  : Load TidyTuesday Datasets from GitHub by Title
- [`logr_msg()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/ttdviewer/reference/logr_msg.md)
  : Log Messages to Console and File
- [`mod_download_server()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/ttdviewer/reference/mod_download_server.md)
  : Data Download Server Module
- [`mod_download_ui()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/ttdviewer/reference/mod_download_ui.md)
  : Data Download UI Module
- [`mod_input_server()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/ttdviewer/reference/mod_input_server.md)
  : Dataset Title Input Server Module
- [`mod_input_ui()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/ttdviewer/reference/mod_input_ui.md)
  : Dataset Title Input UI Module
- [`mod_list_server()`](https://mjfrigaard.github.io/ttdviewer/reference/mod_list_server.md)
  : List Server Module (listviewerlite)

  : List UI Module (listviewerlite)

  : Inspect Plot Module Server
